pipeline: paper-orchestra (outline -> verified literature -> sections -> review -> format)
stage1_outline: outline.json: 2 figures (system diagram drawn by the author; pilot results drawn with code), 3 related-work clusters, MDPI sections

stage2_literature.how: title, authors, year and venue read on the source page (arXiv, ACL Anthology, PMLR, conference and repository pages); the scholarly APIs were not reachable from the build machine

stage4_sections: all sections written from inputs/idea.md and inputs/experimental_log.md; numbers checked against v0_mvp/results.csv

stage5_review_round1.reviewer: inline review with the AgentReview rubric (internal estimate, not a prediction of acceptance)
addressed_weaknesses: FAR related to the precision of positive claims, and why it is always reported next to VRR (Section 3.4)
abstract cut to 199 words (MDPI limit about 200)
VulRepair, IntroClass and oracle-script sentences corrected to match the sources
integrated_answers: how the five cases were chosen (first five of the benchmark list)
what the model received in CVE-2019-1010017
deferred_to_authors: a sample-size and hypothesis plan for the main study is not in the inputs
how to cite the laboratory reference run

stage5_format: compiled with the official MDPI class (Definitions/ from the MDPI Article Template provided by the author), journal option 'ai', 10 pages, no undefined citations or references and no overfull lines; the local build replaced the bbm font package, which this paper does not use, with a stand-in
